honest_summary: The wave-15 membrane -- THE LEVEL ENTRY, re-derive the entry trunk lean so the strut difference stays inside the 5.9 cm survivable band -- is DERIVED, BUILT, AND FALSIFIED, and the falsification is the most informative of the campaign. The derivation held: the strut law (D = raw heel - the seat's lowest raw + 2e-6) was measured on the Assembly at three leans, validated against the wave-14 runtime tick-0 gap to 9e-5 m, and its unique minimum theta_e=0 (D=4.62 cm, band theta >= -0.0449 rad) coincides with the vault table's own zero crossing phi_z=0.1418 (the wave-8 opposite-sign phase 0.35 confirmed at +0.396 rad). Built and run, the membrane's TARGET was verified: the settle strut storm is GONE (F-G15 census worst 4.5682e-2 m at tick 0, decaying; spread inside the survived anchor; the settle completed and the capture FIRED at tick 60 -- the first capture past the wave-14 branch), and the walk lived 180 ticks -- 6x wave-14's 30 and 1.5x wave-13's 120. But the run falsifier fired at 180 with the membrane's OWN named tension measured: the vault lean was LOADING THE FORE STANCE. Level, the CoM (0.0232) sits 0.117 m behind the hind contact line (0.140), the body tips backward about the hind contacts (the posture servo rails at -11.2125 N.m from tick ~20; trunk 0 -> 7.79 deg at the capture -> 43.96 deg at the refusal; base sinks 0.345 -> 0.168), the fore pads unload (reactions <= 3.3 N, slip 0.79 m/s -- they slide, never plant, and the s=0.45 statics share never materializes), the capture-equation's hold-invariance is falsified (measured capture +0.1396/+0.1400 vs predicted +0.0225/+0.0283 -- the -0.095 m fold transfer exists only under the lean's fore load; the arms stayed extended at h=0.177 m instead of folding to 0.0817), the captured spots are deserted (paw error 0.105 m), support decays 2 -> 1 -> 0, and the impact budget refuses at 180. Two latent committed defects were found and handled: the wave-14 fore-clock units bug (seconds * 213-ticks-per-cycle; latent because wave-14's clock never armed) was REPAIRED as run 2's single itemized fix -- run 2's arm measured the derived grid slots to the tick (92.229/198.729) -- and the hind reset assembles the right leg at the phi=1.0==0.0 column against its 0.5 clock (measured: L/R hind dangles 4.575/4.557 cm vs derived 4.62/9.19) -- hind machinery, out of scope, banked with evidence. The scene's vestigial single-support require was replaced on the quadruped path by the strut bound itself (the L/R fore symmetry makes the old ordering impossible at level; the new requires are strictly stronger). GREEN: the strut census, the compile-time seating + level statics, IK closure (exact to 0.0), F-G5 (-9.806650 exact), F-G7 (bit-identical, both runs), the 19 graph tests, the elbow ceiling. RED: run (180 < 426), capture_central, reach (45/29 > 10, the tip), paw_band (breach at the capture tick), vault_handoff's level-at-capture clause (+7.79 deg), support census (min 0). NOT MEASURED: stagger in substance, second-cycle vault tracking, ledger comparison across lifetimes, F-G1..G3. NEXT MEMBRANE (banked): the entry must load the fore stance WHILE keeping the strut difference in band -- the strut bound and the fore load are the same quantity read from opposite sides (the lean drops the forward paw AND presses it down). The lawful candidates the evidence names: (a) a partial entry lean INSIDE the derived admissible band (theta in [-0.0449, 0]: at theta=-0.0449 the strut difference is exactly 5.9 cm and the fore pads carry the lean's preload -- the band edge is the load/strut trade's own corner, derivable from the measured 13.58 N-at-full-lean point); (b) the hind reset fix (the phi-column inconsistency) which changes the entry load path wholesale and is owed anyway. F-G1..G3 remain unmeasured pending a walk that lives past cycle 3.
